info.title: Index Options AI
info.description:
Local REST API for the Index Options AI intraday trading workstation (NIFTY and BANKNIFTY index options/futures on the Dhan broker).

**Unauthenticated.** The server binds to 127.0.0.1 and ships no auth layer; every endpoint is open to any local client. Do not expose it to a network.

Request and response bodies are loosely typed (`application/json` objects); the schemas here capture the fields the handlers read, not an exhaustive contract.
